eject: The pilot can eject from the plane.
飞行员可以从飞机上弹射出来。
Watch the toaster eject the bread!
快看烤面包机把面包弹出来！
What made the pilot eject from the plane?
飞行员为什么会从飞机上弹射出去呀？
elder: We help the elders in our family.
我们会帮家里的长辈做事。
Listen to your elders at home.
Will you read to the elders today?
你今天会念书给长辈听吗？
elect: The people will elect new helpers for the city.
人们要为城市选出新的帮手。
Elect a friend who always helps you.
选那位总是帮助你的朋友吧。
Who will the people elect tomorrow?
election: The election for the new helper starts at nine.
新帮手的选举九点开始。
What a big day for the election!
今天可是选举的大日子呀！
学校的选举在哪里举行呀？
electric: The electric train is very fast.
Turn on the electric light, please.
Does the electric car make any noise?
电动车开起来有声音吗？
elevated: The elevated train goes over the street.
高架火车从街道上方开过。
Sit in the elevated seats with me!
来和我一起坐高高的座位吧！
Is the new bridge elevated over the river?
新桥是高架在河面上的吗？
emergency: Ask a helper for help in an emergency!
紧急情况要找大人帮忙！
The fire truck comes fast in an emergency.
紧急的时候消防车会飞快赶来。
What do you do in an emergency?
紧急情况时你该怎么办呀？
empire: The old empire had many big cities.
Read this story about a big empire!
来读读这个关于大帝国的故事吧！
emu: The emu is a big bird that cannot fly.
鸸鹋是一种不会飞的大鸟。
Wow, an emu can run very fast!
enchanted: The fairy lives in an enchanted forest.
Is the old tree enchanted too?
那棵老树也被施了魔法吗？
Let's read the story of the enchanted lake!
我们一起读魔法湖泊的故事吧！
enclosure: The horses eat grass inside the enclosure.
Close the gate of the enclosure, please!
What animal lives in this enclosure?
这个围栏里住着什么动物呀？
encourage: My mother will encourage me at the game.
比赛的时候妈妈会给我打气。
Please encourage your friend to try again.
请鼓励你的朋友再试一次。
Who encourages you to read more?
encyclopedia: The encyclopedia tells about animals, plants, and more.
百科全书里讲动物、植物等各种知识。
What did you find in the encyclopedia?
你在百科全书里查到了什么呀？
Look it up in the encyclopedia!
去百科全书里查一查吧！
endangered: The panda is an endangered animal.
为什么有些动物会濒临灭绝呀？
enslave: The old story tells how people were enslaved.
这个老故事讲了人们曾被奴役的事。
Today, no one can enslave another kid!
现在谁也不能奴役别的孩子！
Is it bad to enslave people?
entertain: The monkey can entertain the kids at the circus.
马戏团里的猴子会逗孩子们开心。
Sing a song to entertain your friends!
唱首歌逗朋友们开心吧！
什么能让小宝宝开心呀？
entrance: This is the entrance of the school.
Walk to the entrance and open the door.
Where is the entrance of the big building?
那栋大楼的入口在哪里呀？
envelope: I put the letter in the envelope.
Please give the red envelope to your grandmother.
请把这个红信封交给奶奶。
What is inside the big envelope?
equality: Equality is when every kid gets a turn.
平等就是每个孩子都能轮到。
Take your turn and play with equality!
What does equality look like at school?
学校里的平等是什么样子的呀？
equator: The equator is a line on the map.
赤道是地图上的一条线。
Is it very hot near the equator?
赤道附近是不是特别热呀？
Draw the equator on your paper!
erupt: Hot rock and fire erupt from the big hole.
炙热的岩石和火焰从大洞里喷出来。
Run if the big hole starts to erupt!
大洞要是开始喷发，就快跑！
When will the hot hole erupt again?
那个热洞什么时候会再喷发呀？
evidence: The wet mud is evidence of a big animal.
湿泥巴就是有大动物来过的证据。
What evidence did you find in the garden?
你在花园里找到了什么证据呀？
examine: Let's examine the little bug under the log.
我们来观察木头底下的小虫子吧。
We examine leaves in the classroom.
我们在教室里观察树叶。
What did you examine at the pond today?
你今天在池塘边观察了什么呀？
